summary_provenance: Extracted complete JSON from the published CI job log groups named allocations and timing. Only the log timestamp prefix and enclosing workflow group markers were removed; numeric values were not changed.
test_reporting_note: The original runner records only the final Swift Testing process count in manifest.tests[].passed. Swift 6.4 emits separate 13-test core and 6-test app results. Both suites passed (19 total) in each configuration. The follow-up runner sums process counts and requires each named suite; historical artifact manifests are unmodified.
limits: Component qualification, not a full app build or live UI qualification.
Requested allocation traffic is not live or peak memory, RSS, or macOS physical footprint.
Complete original per-process observations, test logs, calibration and source hashes remain in the linked GitHub artifacts, subject to their expiration dates.

An earlier local Linux Swift 6.3.2 timing run had a noisy 100000/miss counterexample (median paired CPU change +5.51%, 3 of 6 pairs faster); its uncommitted raw local receipts became unavailable after workspace interruption and are not reproduced here.
